title: 🗂️ Mission — Modular Security System
subtitle: Split your code into a security.py module, then import and use it.
instructions: Replace each ??? — one inside security.py's function, one where you call it. The SETUP section is done for you: it creates security.py as a real, separate file so you can genuinely import it, just like a real Python project.

hints: Inside security.py, check_pin should compare pin to correct using == — replace "???" with pin == correct (no quotes, since this is a real comparison, not text).
To call a function from an imported file, use dot notation: security.check_pin(...)
Try security.check_pin("1234", "1234") to test it — it should print True.
